text: APPROVE. Merging the first two `continue` guards keeps the same order and short-circuit behaviour, and moving the entry checks into `DisabledEntryKey` returns null at exactly the points where the loop used to `continue`, so the method's complexity drops well below 15 with behaviour unchanged.
